primitives.name: Build System Compiler Directive
primitives.verbatim_quote: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20) project(gse_native_kernels LANGUAGES C CXX) set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11) set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON) add_compile_options(-O3 -Wall -Wextra) include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include) add_library(gse_native_kernels SHARED src/gse_c_sinkhorn_and_dk_scoring.c src/gse_cpp_trajectory_and_copula.cpp ) target_compile_definitions(gse_native_kernels PRIVATE GSE_BUILDING_DLL) add_executable(test_native_kernels tests/test_native_kernels_main.cpp src/gse_c_sinkhorn_and_dk_scoring.c src/gse_cpp_trajectory_and_copula.cpp ) target_compile_definitions(test_native_kernels PRIVATE GSE_BUILDING_DLL)
primitives.assumptions: Compiler standards are enforced; optimization level -O3 is assumed optimal for performance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs at incompatible C/C++ standard versions or missing include paths.
